Perfect Cast fish fingers.d: Panko-crusted white fish, lemon and a pickle and caper tartare.
Perfect Cast fish fingers.note: Practice your Perfect Cast at the pond out back.

Powerline concert nachos.d: Corn chips, spiced beef, black beans, cheddar, guacamole, sour cream, salsa.
Powerline concert nachos.note: Powerline plays L.A. this summer. Take the south road at the fork.

Pete's RV barbecue sausages.d: Chargrilled beef sausages in rolls, fried onions, mustard, ketchup, buttered corn.
Pete's RV barbecue sausages.note: Big rigs and RVs park out back.

Bigfoot campsite s'mores.d: Toasted marshmallow and milk chocolate between graham crackers.
Bigfoot campsite s'mores.note: Bigfoot country ahead. Lock your cooler.

Concert night cherry slushie.d: Cherry syrup blended with crushed ice and a squeeze of lime.
Concert night cherry slushie.note: In the Powerline tour cup, while they last.
